content.english: I will speak my mind regarding age-old [matters],
I will declare the righteous deeds of my God and my rescuer:

content.hebrew: בְּשֵֽׁשֶׁת יָמִים כִּלָּה כֹּל, מַלְכִּי וְרֹעִי,
content.transliteration: Besheshet yamim killa kol, malki vero‘i,
content.english: In six days He finished everything—my king and my shepherd,
And God blessed the seventh day.   (Gen. 2:3)

content.transliteration: Hifli kol po‘al, vehodo shamayim kissa,
content.english: He wondrously wrought everything, and His splendor covered heaven.
May the high and lofty One be elevated and uplifted,

content.hebrew: הַמְקַדֵּשׁ זֶה הַיּוֹם מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשָׂה,
content.transliteration: Hameḳaddesh zé hayyom mikkol asher na‘asa,
content.english: He who sanctified this day from everything that had been made,
From all His labor that He had done.    (Gen. 2:2)
The beginning of His word is truth, in a concealed secret.
The nation He chose as an estate, from long ago,
He commanded to prepare for themselves a double portion of bread—

content.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לְדֹרֹתָם בְּרִית עוֹלָם. (שמות לא:טז)
content.english: To observe the Sabbath, for [all] their generations, an eternal covenant. (Exod. 31:16)
He bequeathed a testimony as an inheritance to the children of Jacob, for their glory:

content.hebrew: יוֹם עֹֽנֶג, יוֹם קֹֽדֶשׁ, יוֹם מְכֻבָּד לִכְבוֹדָם.
content.transliteration: Yom ‘oneg yom ḳodesh, yom mechubbad lichvodam.
content.english: The day of enjoyment, the day of holiness, the honored day, for their honor.
Indeed, they tell of His righteous deeds when they assemble together,

content.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיוי חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם. (תהלים קז:ח)
content.transliteration: Yodu ladonai ḥasdo, venifle’otav livné adam.
content.english: They thank Adonai for His kindness, and for His wondrous deeds for people. (Ps. 107:8)

content.hebrew: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִ֖ים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ: (תהלים קמ:יד) וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יו֑י אַף־אֱ֝מ֥וּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים: (תהלים פט:ו) פְּד֤וּת ׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ: (תהלים קיא:ט) צַֽהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיהו יב:ו)
content.transliteration: Ach tsaddiḳim yodu lishemcha yeshevu yesharim et panecha: Veyodu shamayim pil’acha adonai af emunatecha biḳhal ḳedoshim: Pedut, shalaḥ le‘ammo tsivva le‘olam berito ḳadosh venora shemo: Tsahali varonni yoshevet tsiyyon, ki ḡadol beḳirbech ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Truly, the righteous give acknowledgment to Your name; the upright sit facing You. (Ps. 140:14) And heaven will acknowledge Your miracle, Adonai, and Your steadfastness is with the community of holy people. (Ps. 89:6) He sent deliverance to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name! (Ps. 111:9) Rejoice and sing out, dweller of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great in Your midst! (Isa. 12:6)

content.hebrew: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיה מז:ד)
content.english: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
